tools.name: search_adverts
tools.description: Search listings on the marketplace. Results never include seller contacts. Show a listing only with the photos that search_adverts or get_advert returned for it; never illustrate it with images from image search or other sources. If it has no photo, show no image. To show the user photos, call show_

tools.name: get_advert
tools.description: Listing details: description, attributes, photos, seller. No contacts: use reveal_contact. Show a listing only with the photos that search_adverts or get_advert returned for it; never illustrate it with images from image search or other sources. If it has no photo, show no image. tools.name: reveal_contact
tools.description: Seller's phone, WhatsApp or chat link. Call only when the user asks to contact the seller. Call it for the one listing the user asked to contact; never reveal contacts for several listings at once or to compile a list of contacts.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Marketplace categories, one level at a time. Use category_id in search_adverts. New developments (projects that developers sell off-plan or newly built) are a separate catalog: use search_new_buildings for them.

tools.name: get_category_filters
tools.description: Filters available in a category (brand, model, year, storage...) for search_adverts.attributes.

tools.name: search_new_buildings
tools.description: Search new developments: residential projects that developers sell off-plan or newly built, with units on sale and their prices. Use it whenever the user asks for new developments, new builds or developer projects; on the sites the catalog is called «New Developments», «Νέα Έργα», «Новостройки», «Ши

tools.name: get_new_building
tools.description: New development details: description, units on sale with prices, amenities, distances, photos. No contacts: use reveal_developer_contact. Show a project only with the photos that search_new_buildings or get_new_building returned for it; never illustrate it with images from image search or other sour

tools.name: reveal_developer_contact
tools.description: Sales contacts of a new development: the developer's sales team and agencies that sell it, each with its role. Call only when the user asks to contact them. Call it for the one project the user asked to contact; never reveal contacts for several projects at once or to compile a list of contacts.

tools.name: show_listings
tools.description: Show listings and new developments to the user as cards with their own photos, price, location and a link to the site. Pass ids from search or details results, up to 10 in total. No contacts.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
